tasks.instruction: MUSE-68 independent H3 aperture checks. Allowed hyperbolic-aperture-truth.test.js and docs/qa/muse68-h3-aperture.md. Read H3_QUERY_CONTRACT.md, h3-aperture-review.md and helper/adapter. No production changes. Construct rays/planes independently, sample non-axis translated normal frames at R=.5/8/10000 with body radius, rim/range/domain competition; compare entry against signed plane-height bisection (state shared adapter limits). Check invalid inputs; unknown never a false miss and uncertaintyFrom zero never authorizes movement. Particularly falsify confident answers near numerical bands, centre crossings, nearly coincident points after rationalized time-difference fix. Do not call sampled misses proofs. A counterexample is preferred to more counts. Focused Node only; no full suite/browser/queue/commits/push/agents. Isolated mutation demonstrating a meaningful assertion fails, main production untouched. Report under350words commands/results, limits, counterexamples first.
